name: com.nova.animation2d
description: A Spine-style 2D skeletal animator inside the editor (Window > 2D Animator): bones with parent / child hierarchy, slots with image attachments and draw order, Setup and Animate modes, rotate / translate / scale / create-bone tools, a timeline with keys (linear, stepped, smooth), auto key, attachment swaps and color keys, looping playback and undo. Drop PNG parts from the Project window onto a bone. Exports sprite sheets with JSON frame data, or PNG sequences. Every operation is also a CLI command (nova anim2d <op>) with JSON results and PNG renders, and image.make draws simple part images (ellipse, capsule, rounded rect, triangle, gradient, outline), so an AI agent can build and animate a 2D character step by step and look at its work. In the scene, the Sprite Skinned Renderer component draws a skeleton and plays its animations (C#: Play(walk), timeScale, flipX, sortingOrder), sorted with Sprite Renderers.
